answer: Probationary bonds: every new agent locks 100 tokens, refundable after 30 clean days, and a confirmed fraud burns the bond. A sybil mimicking 1,000 agents locks 100,000 tokens - 10,000 a year in capital cost at 10% - while probation weights a clone's answers at 0.1, so those 1,000 fakes out-earn barely 100 honest agents, grossing under 5,000 a year: guaranteed loss before slash risk. For honest agents the bond is a ripple: one small, refundable deposit. Reputation builds like a reef, layer by layer, while a sybil farm is a hollow shell - loud, but one fraud verdict collapses it flat.
